necessary_context.content: Integer p>=1; f:R^n->R is C^p and bounded below. For every x,y, ||D^p f(x)-D^p f(y)||_T <= (p-1)! L ||x-y|| with L>=0. Vector norm is Euclidean; tensor norm is recursively induced. T_p is the degree-p Taylor polynomial at x evaluated at displacement s.
necessary_context.name: Standing model and norms

necessary_context.content: m(x,s,sigma)=T_p(x,s)+sigma||s||^(p+1)/(p+1). Model decrease and approximate model stationarity suffice; a global model minimum is not required. Internal model optimization is excluded from original-function evaluation complexity.
necessary_context.locator: PDF pp.3–5, (2.5), Algorithm 2.1 and following discussion
necessary_context.name: Regularization and resource separation
